name: D-09 Corruption Droid
description: The D-09 Corruption Droid was a model of battle droid that was used by the Dread Host, the armies of the Dread Masters during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. D-09 Corruption Droids and similar models were stationed at the Dread Fortress under the command of the droid Corruptor Zero, and fought to defend the fortress during the Dread War.
